feat: update to v14

Bumps @miden-sdk/miden-sdk to ^0.14.4. The JS-wrapper class formerly
exported as `WebClient` now ships as `WasmWebClient` (the bare WASM
class is what `WebClient` resolves to in v14), so all client construction
and `instanceof` checks switch over.

Other v14 adaptations:
- proveTransaction(tx, prover) is split: keep proveTransaction(tx) for
  the default prover, use proveTransactionWithProver(tx, prover) when
  passing one explicitly.
- TransactionRequestBuilder.withOwnOutputNotes now takes a NoteArray of
  raw Notes, not an OutputNoteArray of OutputNote.full(...) wrappers.
- exportNoteFile takes the NoteExportFormat enum instead of a string.
- Debug export/import pages move to the standalone exportStore /
  importStore functions.
- Bump local-storage and metadata cache keys to force a clean wallet on
  upgrade since the underlying account format changed.
